title: fix: guard against None new_accepted_tokens in vocab boundary check
body:
## Summary

_check_vocab_boundary_finish crashes with TypeError when new_accepted_tokens is None and vocab_size is also None (e.g. embedding requests). Add explicit None check to prevent the error.
